question: **Describe how you will tell your friends that Rohit helps Reghu in passive voice. **

options.text: Reghu will been helped by Rohit.
Reghu is being help by Rohit.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Reghu is helped by Rohit.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Therefore, "Rohit helps Reghu" becomes "**Reghu is helped by Rohit.**"
 
• The sentence is in present tense and passive voice, so the helping verb "**is**" is used along with the main verb "**helped**."
 
• The subject "**Reghu**" comes before the verb, and the doer "**Rohit**" comes after the verb with the preposition "**by**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Reghu will been helped by Rohit**" is incorrect as it uses the future tense "will" and the past participle "been" together, which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• "**Rohit help Reghu**" is incorrect as it is in active voice and does not follow the subject-verb-object order of a passive sentence.
 
• "**Reghu is being help by Rohit**" is incorrect as it uses the present participle "being" along with the main verb, which is not required in this sentence.
